SBPF instruction and opcode bitfield definitions with pack, unpack, and start/end checks.

# Purpose
Defines the SBPF instruction data layout and opcode bit fields used to decode and encode one 64-bit instruction word. The file declares `fd_sbpf_opcode_any_t`, `fd_sbpf_opcode_normal_t`, `fd_sbpf_opcode_mem_t`, and `fd_sbpf_instr_t` so code can access opcode, register, offset, and immediate fields by name. It also provides inline helpers to convert between `ulong` and `fd_sbpf_instr_t`, and to test whether an instruction marks a function start or function end by checking fixed opcode values and register fields.
